sloka: एषा वेदवती नाम पूर्वमासीत्कृते युगे ।त्रेतायुगमनुप्राप्य वधार्थं तस्य रक्षसः ।। ७.१७.४२ ॥
transliteration: eṣā vedavatī nāma pūrvamāsītkṛte yuge ।tretāyugamanuprāpya vadhārthaṁ tasya rakṣasaḥ ।। 7.17.42 ॥

translations.english: Thus, this highly fortunate one will again be born among mortals, in a field drawn out by the ploughshare, appearing like a flame of fire on the sacrificial ground.
